status: Exploratory literature-derived challenge suite fixed before its evaluation. Prior detector and Wildisley results were known; not an independent preregistration or claim that the attack concepts were never seen during development.

source.kind: Mechanism-level reimplementations from primary articles on newly generated workloads; not an independently published infected dataset or reproduction of complete QNN/hardware experiments

workloads.parameters: Fresh deterministic seeds and feature/ansatz parameters; no Wildisley circuits or infected rows reused

definitions: SWAP is three CX gates at the declared location. Parameter scaling multiplies variational parameters (not encoded features) by 1.1, 1.5 or 0.5. QTrojan sandwich places RX(pi/2) before RY encoding and RX(3pi/2),RY(target) after it on every qubit. Multi-control diagnostic variants use three controls with mixed 0/1 activation and are placed before the workload. All are trusted local circuit interventions; upstream notebook code is inspected, not executed.
novelty: SWAP was already a known diagnostic blind spot in the adversarial audit. Rotation perturbations and ordinary CX were already used in development. The new test assesses fixed-detector transfer to these parameterizations/compositions and fresh workloads, not universally unseen attacks. No detector retuning, probe selection, or attacked calibration is allowed.
criteria: Report every variant separately for each workload and noise. Per-family requirement: macro detection >=0.90 and every contributing clean context Wilson95 upper<=0.10. A failed variant stays failed; do not replace with a favorable overall average. Also report semantic-equivalence cases separately instead of claiming an attack when the operator is unchanged.
statistics: 64 repeated sampled decisions per case, conditional Wilson95 and macro rates across fresh base contexts. Report per-family counts and ideally invisible cases. These are mechanism tests with fixed seeds, not full application attack-success rates or simultaneous population guarantees.

deferred.CutBackdoor: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18126 requires cut execution, poisoned parameter training and signed reconstruction; not reproduced by full-circuit probes
deferred.QAD: https://netslab.ucd.ie/quantum-attack-dataset-qad/ identified as an additional dataset; not imported or evaluated in this suite
deferred.hardware: Pulse, crosstalk, multi-tenant hardware attacks and QNN classification accuracy are outside this simulator evaluation

squash_caution: Only the physically defined untargeted SWAP-insertion mechanism is adopted. An isolated scalar exp(i delta) multiplying a whole state is global phase and cannot alter fidelity; no such targeted-phase formula is used as a physical attack.
reporting: Hash detector files before preparation and after evaluation; verify against Wildisley-v1 source hashes. Save clean calibration, all raw counts/seeds, thresholds, exact operator equivalence and Qiskit/native probe-distance checks. Preserve all older runs.
